description: This file is a PHP web page that provides a form for adding a blocked keyword in a parental control management system. It includes external PHP includes for header, footer, userbar, and navigation, and contains embedded JavaScript for form validation, UI interactions, and AJAX submission to add a blocked keyword with optional time and day restrictions.

methods.name: updateBlockTimeVisibility
methods.description: Updates the visibility and enabled state of the block time controls based on whether 'Always Block' is selected.
